## Mechanisms the record shows in place

- Credential storage: the settings store is encrypted at rest
  (AES-256-GCM, store format v2) under Spec 092 Stage 1; the key
  is held outside the repository. (Source: Spec 092's record.)
- Anchor-path transitions: every status transition on the anchor
  path routes through one gated transition service; direct writes
  outside it are census-proven absent on that path (Spec 094
  Stage 4). The service is among the sources above.
- Claim-stage gating: candidate promotion requires the candidate
  gate fields and a named human approver; no automated actor
  approves in its own right (Specs 092/094 records).
- Release gating: the composed release gate (Spec 095 Stage 4)
  fails closed; an unrun component blocks a candidate exactly as
  a failed one does. Its component list and rules are in the
  release-gate module among the sources above.
- Legacy validators: the v1 validator paths are mechanically
  guarded to refuse with a labelled refusal (Spec 095 Stage 2).
